_comment: An SCA submission (src/ + xpi/) whose shipped XPI is byte-for-byte what the archive holds: every file it ships - script, manifest.json and icon - is identical to a file in src/, so nothing was built and the XPI on its own would have been a complete review target. sca-not-required therefore warns (src/checks/rules/sca-not-required.js, input: both - the comparison needs both artifacts). The review is NOT re-routed: this stays a full SCA review, so the src/ tree IS reviewed and the build checks DO run, which is why src/ carries a package.json. The XPI carries no vendoring information of its own, so the other half of the check is silent and this fixture exercises the twin half alone. The finding names NO file - its subject is the submission as a whole - so the harness records it as (add-on) and the report prints the entry with no locus line at all.
